statements.status_notes: No upstream fix is available. Debian lists cairo 1.18.4-1 on trixie as vulnerable and unfixed. dhi/pkg-cairo ships libcairo2 containing the vulnerable converter code; absence of WebKitGTK from this package SBOM does not prove the converter path is unreachable for all catalog consumers. Image-scoped VEX may apply where a specific consumer demonstrates an unreachable execute path.
